name: Bottom-nav smoke
description: Launches Sample Shop and switches between all three bottom-nav tabs by driving the shipped mauto CLI (launch, elements, tap, assert). Targets are on-screen strings only. Each tab is proven active by the app-bar header, which the matcher finds before the nav label: the header text equals the tab name only on that tab. The Home tab is targeted by its tab semantics label 'Tab 1 of 3' rather than 'Home', because 'Home & Kitchen' (a Categories tile, onstage on Categories and leaked offstage on every other tab by #251) is listed before the nav item and would be tapped instead.

steps.description: Wait for the Home app-bar title, which confirms the app launched and rendered

steps.expected_state: More tab is selected and the app bar reads 'More'
Categories tab is selected and the app bar reads 'Categories'

steps.description: Tap the Home bottom-nav tab (its label reads 'Home' then 'Tab 1 of 3'; 'Home' alone would match 'Home & Kitchen' first)
steps.expected_state: Home tab is selected and the app bar reads 'Sample Shop'

assertions.description: The first element matching 'More' is the app-bar header reading exactly 'More', which is only true on the More tab (the nav label alone reads 'More\nTab 3 of 3')
The first element matching 'Categories' is the app-bar header reading exactly 'Categories', which is only true on the Categories tab
The app-bar title reads 'Sample Shop', which is only true on the Home tab
